lessons.title: Boss: The Free-Delivery Question
lessons.goal: 整合餐點需求、免運門檻與總預算，避免只看促銷。
lessons.story:
[Picnic order]
Twelve students are planning lunch together. Four have requested vegetable sandwiches, and eight have requested rice boxes. They need exactly one meal each. Their total budget, including delivery, is $600.

[Shop prices]
Vegetable sandwich: $40 each
Rice box: $50 each
Delivery: $30 per order
Delivery is free when the food subtotal reaches $600. Drinks do not count toward this amount. There are no other fees or discounts.

[Team chat]
Nora: Our twelve meals cost $560 before delivery. We can afford the order.
Ian: What if we add one vegetable sandwich? Then delivery will be free.
Nora: We would pay $40 more for food but save only $30 on delivery. Does anyone need a thirteenth meal?
Ian: No. I was looking only at the word “free.” Let's keep the original order and check the final bill before paying.

words.example: The food subtotal is five hundred sixty dollars.
The subtotal must reach six hundred dollars.
We can afford the original order.
Keep the original order of twelve meals.

questions.prompt: How many rice boxes do the students need?
options: Four.
Twelve.
Eight.
Thirteen.
questions.explanation: 八位指定飯盒，四位指定蔬菜三明治。
questions.evidence: Four have requested vegetable sandwiches, and eight have requested rice boxes.

options: When food and delivery together cost $600.
Whenever twelve meals are ordered.
Whenever an order includes drinks.
When the food subtotal is at least $600.
questions.explanation: 免運判準是食物小計達到600，不含運費或飲料。
questions.evidence: Delivery is free when the food subtotal reaches $600.
reasons: 運費不能算入食物小計。
正確使用食物小計門檻。

questions.prompt: What is the food subtotal for the requested twelve meals?
questions.evidence: Nora: Our twelve meals cost $560 before delivery.
reasons: 600是加一個三明治後的食物小計。
四個三明治加八個飯盒為560。

questions.prompt: How much does the original order cost including delivery?
questions.explanation: 食物560未達免運門檻，所以加30，共590。

questions.prompt: Why does Ian first suggest an extra sandwich?
options: He wants to replace all the rice boxes.
He thinks a sandwich costs less than $30.
He has received a request from a thirteenth student.
He focuses on removing the delivery charge.
questions.explanation: Ian承認只注意到免費配送，沒有先比較總費用。
questions.evidence: Ian: No. I was looking only at the word “free.”
reasons: 他回答沒有多一人需求。

questions.prompt: Which lesson is most strongly supported?
options: Compare the whole cost with the actual need.
Count delivery charges as part of the food subtotal.
Treat every extra item as a necessary purchase.
Choose the order with the largest number of items.
questions.explanation: 除了免運，還要檢查加購成本及是否真的需要。
questions.evidence: Does anyone need a thirteenth meal?
reasons: 結合前一句成本比較與本句需求檢查。
人數固定，不是愈多愈好。

questions.prompt: What does “afford” mean in Nora’s first message?
options: Divide food into exactly equal pieces.
Deliver meals before they become cold.
Have enough money to pay for something.
Receive an order without paying anything.
questions.explanation: 預算600可支付590，所以afford是負擔得起。
questions.evidence: Nora: Our twelve meals cost $560 before delivery. We can afford the order.
reasons: 金額在預算內，能夠支付。

questions.prompt: How would one extra vegetable sandwich change the final cost?
options: It would rise by $40, from $590 to $630.
It would fall by $30, from $590 to $560.
It would stay at $590 because delivery is free.
It would rise by $10, from $590 to $600.
questions.explanation: 新食物小計600且免運；原總價590，所以增加10。
questions.evidence: We would pay $40 more for food but save only $30 on delivery.
reasons: 只算省運費，漏加購成本。

questions.prompt: Which statement compares the two choices correctly?
options: The original order needs one fewer rice box to fit the budget.
Only the extra-item order can stay within the $600 budget.
The original order meets all requests and leaves $10; the extra-item order leaves $0.
Both orders meet the requests and leave $30 each.
questions.explanation: 原單590留10，追加單600留0；原單已滿足十二份指定需求。
questions.evidence: Their total budget, including delivery, is $600.
reasons: 原單已不超支，不必刪飯盒。
結合需求、預算與兩種總價。
